headline: On November 5, 2007: Google unveils Android OS
captionCards: Android now has 4 billion users worldwide
Android is the most used OS for smartphones
instagramCaption:
Google introduces the Android mobile operating system. \\[Blank Line] On November 5, 2007, Google unveiled Android, an open-source operating system designed for smartphones and tablets. Based on a modified Linux kernel, Android was first released in 2008 and has since become the world's most popular mobile OS with 4 billion users. Today, Android powers a vast majority of the world's smartphones, making it a cornerstone of modern mobile technology. \\[Blank Line] How has Android changed your smartphone experience? \\[Blank Line] Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
